## Scope Check

Before submitting, confirm this is within Phase 1 scope.

The following are **out of scope** and will be closed without action:
- Push notifications, Keychain storage, token refresh, deep links (Phase 2)
- Fastlane, CI/CD, OTA updates (Phase 3)
- New UI screens unrelated to the template structure
- Third-party UI library integrations
- State management library replacements

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and this request is within Phase 1 scope
